content: Each reference is presented as a complete and coherent citation. 1. Wilson AA. The impact of management development on nurse retention was explored in the journal Nursing Administration Quarterly. This study highlights the importance of leadership strategies in retaining nursing staff. Accessed February 1, 2021. 2. Squires A. The orientation of new graduate nurses in rural community hospitals was examined in the Journal of Continuing Education in Nursing. This research underscores the challenges and solutions for integrating new nurses into rural healthcare settings. Accessed February 1, 2021. 3. MacVicar R, Clarke G, Hogg DR. Scotland’s GP Rural Fellowship initiative has significantly influenced rural recruitment and retention of general practitioners. Published in Rural and Remote Health (2016;16(1):3550). 4. Straume K, Shaw DM. Effective physician retention strategies in Norway’s northernmost county were analyzed in the Bulletin of the World Health Organization. This study provides evidence-based recommendations for improving healthcare workforce stability in remote areas. 5. Cross W, Wyman PA. Training and motivational factors were identified as predictors of job satisfaction and anticipated job retention among implementers of school-based prevention programs.
